trajectory_cause: The agent first stated the correct two-projective-measurement interpretation. Its diagnostic sums pi[:,None]*P*delta**n while P=abs(U)**2 has final-state rows and initial-state columns, but pi and delta use initial-state rows. The missing P transpose made that diagnostic fail calibration. The agent then reverted to the operator-moment source.
minimal_diagnostic_repair: Transpose P in the diagnostic weighted moment sum; no other physics, parameters or data change.
final_source_repair: Replace only statistics by the correctly oriented joint measurement probabilities at the same fitted scale. This also restores the initially recognized physical model.
